Class ControllerLessonDetail

java.lang.Object
guiLessonDetail.ControllerLessonDetail
public class ControllerLessonDetail extends Object

Title: ControllerLessonDetail Class.

Description: The Java/FX-based Lesson Detail Page. This class provides the controller actions for examining one lesson: showing its fields with their lock state, saving edits, deleting it after confirmation, and leaving the page. The class has been written assuming that the View or the Model are the only class methods that can invoke these methods. This is why each has been declared at "protected". Do not change any of these methods to public.

  • Method Details

    • showLesson

      protected static void showLesson()

      Method: showLesson()

      Description: Puts the current lesson into the page and applies its lock state (Contributor story 2: "I can see the fields I can alter, and which are locked and unavailable for me to edit"). A locked field cannot be changed and is labeled "Locked by a curator". Delete is disabled when the lesson or any field is locked, with a note saying why, because the story says such a lesson cannot be deleted.

    • performSaveChanges

      protected static void performSaveChanges()

      Method: performSaveChanges()

      Description: Saves the edited values. On success the page shows the stored lesson and "Changes saved." in green. On a validation failure the edits stay on the page, the specific message is shown in red, and the cursor moves to the field to fix. Any other refusal (not found, not the owner) shows that reason, and nothing is changed.

    • performDeleteLesson

      protected static void performDeleteLesson()

      Method: performDeleteLesson()

      Description: Asks "Are you sure?", naming the lesson, and deletes it only on "Yes". As in the team's User Experience document, "No" is the default choice, so pressing Enter or closing the dialog never deletes anything. On success the contributor returns to My Lessons, which shows "Lesson deleted."

    • performBackToMyLessons

      protected static void performBackToMyLessons()

      Method: performBackToMyLessons()

      Description: Returns to My Lessons without saving unsaved edits.
